resources.scope: fresh native source only; five-second samples are a lower bound on instantaneous peak

existing_unmodified_posthoc_all_gap_buck.rule: first GT-aligned candidate after at least one missing candidate observation; same previous emitted ID with matching immutable birth anchor
existing_unmodified_posthoc_all_gap_buck.scope: natural candidate/GT gaps only; no artificial occlusion, future GT correction or recovery metric replacing TrackEval

natural_recovery.policy: All physical marked pedestrian GT, original IoU.5 one-to-one alignment; no visibility filter or artificial proposal removal. New recovery denominator requires a known correct immutable birth anchor; unknown/no anchors are counted separately, not fabricated negatives. Gap lengths are between actual aligned candidates, not GTvisibility endpoints.
